item.title: Coyote: A public experiment in data and analytics for self-directed, informal learning
item.description: What Coyote is, why it's a public experiment rather than a solution, and how it builds a semantic record of your reading — followed through the morning of a Montana woman who has just read that a company wants to put industrial wastewater into her county's aquifer.
